# KANERVA: first steps

## Long random words, tied and voted (FIRST STEPS)

It all comes down to long rows of random bits and two moves on them. A **tie** joins two words into one that looks like neither, and can be undone. A **vote** blends several words into one that looks a little like each. Press the buttons; the numbers are computed as you watch.

Nothing is written yet. Press the first button.
